svg.title: Tester malfunction timeline
svg.desc: A timeline from 165 s to 240 s, the time since the competition started. Top: a plot of tester 1's reading in volts, from -1 to 4. The reading stays near 3.6 V, drops to -1 at 180 s, stays at -1 until 225 s, then returns to about 3.6 V. Dashed vertical lines mark 180 s, tag 1, and 225 s, tag 2. Below, three rows of bars. Status: OPERATIONAL, then MALFUNCTIONING in amber from 180 s to 225 s, then OPERATIONAL. Watcher: UP, then DOWN in amber, then UP. Plan uses: both testers, then tester 2 only (new plan) in red, then both testers in red.
